svg.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
svg.title: Flower Anatomy Drag & Drop
svg.desc: An interactive SVG diagram of a flower with labeled parts, word bank, instructions, and interactive modals for hint, check, and reset.

g.desc: Detailed labeled vector illustration of a flower with arrows pointing to anatomical parts

foreignObject.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; font-size:18px; color:#4a5863; line-height:1.5; user-select:none;

body.p: Drag the labels from the word bank and place them into the correct slots on the flower diagram.
Each slot is marked with a dashed outline where a label should fit.
Use the Hint button if you need assistance identifying part names.
After placing all labels, press Check Answer to see your results.
If you want to start over, press Reset.
Note: In this static demo, drag and drop is simulated using anchor links and toggled popups.

foreignObject.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; font-size:22px; color:#34495e; user-select:none;

ul.li: Petal: Often colorful parts attracting pollinators.
Sepal: Green leaf-like structures beneath petals, protective function.
Stamen: Male part, holds anther and filament.
Anther: Produces pollen, on top of filament.
Pistil: Female part, includes stigma, style, ovary.
Style: Tube connecting stigma to ovary.
Receptacle: Base of flower attaching to stem.
